entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex, how can I help you today?
Yes, hello. I'm calling about a return. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me. I want to return it.
I understand. I can certainly assist you with a return. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
It's order number VP789234. And hurry up, I don't have all day. This VeloBand Pulse smart watch is a piece of junk!
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, placed on October 26th. I'm sorry you're not satisfied with it.
Not satisfied? It barely works! I want to return it! What's the hold up?
No problem at all. According to our return policy, you have 90 days to return items for a full refund. Since you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on October 26th, you are well within that timeframe.
Ninety days? Really? Okay, great! So what do I do now?

I'll go ahead and generate a return label for you. It will be sent to the email address associated with your account within the next hour. Simply pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
Sounds easy enough. What about the refund? How long does that take?

Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, we will process your refund. It usually takes 7-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account. You will receive a confirmation email once the refund has been processed.
Alright, that's acceptable. Thank you. I appreciate the help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
Have a great day! Thank you for choosing VeloFit.
